## Checklist

- [ ] The folder is named like the `id`, and `plugin.json` has a description, author and licence
- [ ] I raised `version` (if this changes an existing plugin) and wrote it in `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] I ran the check from the guide (or the CI is green)
- [ ] The scripts are readable, small, and do what the description says
- [ ] Pictures / data in it are mine or may be shared (licence in the manifest)
- [ ] I tried it in a program (which one and which version?)
